records.title: Hormuz shipping traffic in single digits, data shows
records.claim: Reuters reported preliminary tracking showing seven Hormuz transits on Sep 9, no LNG tanker exit, while Saudi Yanbu crude/condensate loadings rebounded in September.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Hormuz shipping traffic in single digits, data shows

records.boundary: Single-day AIS-based vessel counts can miss dark crossings; Yanbu tracker estimates differ and cannot be applied to LNG/LPG.

records.title: China independent refiners scramble for oil, underpinning spot premiums
records.claim: Chinese independent refiners bought more than 20 million barrels of replacement crude from West Africa, Canada and South America as Iranian and Russian availability thinned, supporting spot premiums.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: China independent refiners scramble for oil, underpinning spot premiums

records.boundary: Purchase volume is trader-estimated rather than official customs data; individual grade premiums do not represent the full market.

records.title: Iran suspends freight charge on foreign vessels carrying energy products to or from Iran
records.claim: Iran temporarily suspended a 10% freight fee on foreign vessels carrying imported/exported oil, gas and liquid petroleum products, aiming to lower transport cost and attract foreign fleets.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Iran suspends freight charge on foreign vessels carrying energy products to or from Iran

records.boundary: Final taxable product scope and actual post-suspension vessel/export response were not disclosed.

records.title: OPEC further lowers 2026 global oil demand growth forecast
records.claim: OPEC lowered its 2026 global oil demand growth forecast to 380,000 bpd, its fifth consecutive downgrade, while raising its 2027 growth forecast.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: OPEC further lowers 2026 global oil demand growth forecast

records.boundary: This is an OPEC forecast, not realized demand; other agencies differ materially.

records.title: Global clean hydrogen investment tops $130 billion amid energy security push, council says
records.claim: Hydrogen Council said committed clean hydrogen investment exceeded $130 billion across more than 570 projects supporting about 6.9 mtpa, while high costs and weak demand still caused cancellations.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Global clean hydrogen investment tops $130 billion amid energy security push, council says

records.boundary: Committed investment is not identical to realized capex or profitability; capacity is not current output.
